name: HT-3
prompt: A hand holding a clear spray bottle misting soapy water onto a bare white fibreglass hull, visible droplets running down the gelcoat. At the very top of the frame, the bottom edge of a plain blank white paper sheet is hinged upward on two strips of blue masking tape - the sheet shows only its blank white paper backing, with no printing, no lettering and no markings of any kind on it. CRITICAL: the hull itself is completely BARE with no lettering, no registration number and no decal anywhere. Ignore any lettering visible in the reference image. Use the reference image ONLY for the boat, trailer, driveway and weather: the SAME white fibreglass runabout on the SAME galvanised trailer in the SAME gravel driveway. Casual smartphone snapshot taken by the boat owner, not a professional photograph. Flat overcast daylight, no direct sun, no golden hour. Slightly off-level handheld framing. Visible sensor noise, water spots and faint scuffs on the hull, a cluttered driveway background. Natural muted colour, no HDR, no glow, nothing airbrushed. Do not render: human faces, brand logos, ANY text or lettering anywhere in the frame, golden-hour light, glossy oversaturated colour, HDR halos, studio lighting, watermark.
